FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (DES-AU-127, agent 128) — growth-project-mobile#504 @ fc01a3c98000fdce2e5c61fd41380fd856b3500b — READY FOR AUDIT

- T1 presentation/copy only, 376 changed lines (244 additions / 132 deletions).
- Four auth screens: calm semantic bone/forest hierarchy, hairline inputs, Inter controls, neutral copy, scrolling recovery forms and visible password requirements. All routes/actions retained; provider button dimensions and native Apple component untouched.
- 109 distinct targeted tests passed locally through heavy.sh, including rendered parity, provider/role/coach-recovery/error-support regressions and doctrine/truthful guards.
- All 18 named auth handlers/effects are AST-identical to main; token/session, reset validator, provider gates and error mapping frozen.
- Main `4185b9b2cb4e415234dc526af0f0da97d2dd8ef4` merged cleanly before READY, no shared README conflict. GitHub reports MERGEABLE.
- Exact-head [CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37690777881) and [CodeQL](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37690777959) are green.
- B=0, U=2 fixed. No production change, PR merge, deployment or store build. Native device screenshot pass not performed.

Both audit lenses are requested at this exact head. Per owner override, the builder now writes HANDOFF/notify and finishes without waiting for verdicts or starting another job.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 (LN-OPUS-B-128) — growth-project-mobile#504 @ fc01a3c98000fdce2e5c61fd41380fd856b3500b — VERDICT: APPROVE

Full review, kept tight (mobile auth, DES-AU). 376 changed lines (+244 / -132) in 9 files. CI and CodeQL are green at this head.

T4 check. The diff touches only labels and styles. `handleLogin`, `handleGoogleLogin`, `handleAppleLogin`, the confirmed provider handler, `acknowledgeRecovery`, `authApi.forgotPassword` and the reset setSession/updateUser/signOut path are untouched, as are the provider visibility gates and the error mapper and its support path. The native Apple button is kept.

I checked the redo rules against the code:
- Rule 1 (honest copy). "Welcome back." becomes "Sign in.", since a returning user is not known. "Submitting..." and "request a reset link" no longer imply delivery. The password policy moves from the placeholder to a visible hint whose wording matches the existing validator (8 characters, uppercase, number, special character). First-person choice labels become neutral, with the same handlers.
- Rule 2 and rules 4/6. Welcome keeps both routes: Sign in goes to Login (now primary) and Create account goes to CreateAccount. Every Login, Forgot and Reset action in the table maps to the same `navigate` or handler in the code, so nothing is lost.
- Rule 7. Only semantic tokens are used. `lightTokens` is a typed fallback default, not a hex value. The status bar follows `colorScheme`. Error text is stated in words with a rule instead of red. Back and support targets are at least 44 pt.

Bs: none.

Cs:
- C: Welcome now makes Sign in primary and Create account secondary. That is a product-emphasis choice for new installs. The operator may prefer Create account as primary before the iOS build.
- C: the title "Sign in." carries a period, which reads as a fragment. Dropping it is purely stylistic.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol (LN-SOL-A-128) — growth-project-mobile#504 @ fc01a3c98000fdce2e5c61fd41380fd856b3500b — VERDICT: APPROVE

B: None. U: None.

Independent full review of 376 changed lines (+244/−132). Changed welcome/login/reset-request copy is neutral or state-backed; the new visible password requirements match the unchanged validator. Welcome retains both account-creation and sign-in routes, with accurately relabelled primary/secondary emphasis. Login provider/policy/recovery gates, session/token/cache handling, forgot-password submission, reset token gates and Supabase update/sign-out handlers are unchanged. [Changed code](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/504/files).

Actions/table match: sign in/create, credentials, forgot password, permitted Google/Apple, existing-account confirmation/new-account choice, support/recovery, reset back/submit, visibility toggle and success login routes remain. Rendered presentation/parity and existing provider/error guards cover those surfaces; the reset done-state test is a render proof, not a Supabase execution claim. Matching auth README rows, semantic colours, scrollable recovery forms and readable controls are present; no new shipped hex palette, dependency or navigator changes. [Tests and documentation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/504/files).

CI: four checks SUCCESS at this exact head, including Typecheck/lint/test. No local/device execution claimed. [CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37690777881).

C: None.

No code change in the delta. New head 431f65b8b239f63f63f7668a82e07d903630a731. Both lenses: please re-check at this head.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 (LN-OPUS-A3-129) — growth-project-mobile#504 @ 431f65b8b239f63f63f7668a82e07d903630a731 — VERDICT: APPROVE

Delta re-review. LN-OPUS-B-128 approved the previous head fc01a3c9 with no Bs. The only new commit is the main merge 431f65b8 (parents fc01a3c9 and main 999ac84c). I compared the PR's own diff before and after the merge: `git diff 4185b9b2 fc01a3c9` and `git diff 999ac84c 431f65b8` are identical (9 files, +244/-132) apart from one README context row, which now carries main's updated `CreateAccountScreen.tsx` entry. So the README resolution kept main's row and this screen's own rows, and no screen code or test changed. At this head, Typecheck/lint/test, CodeQL and both Analyze jobs are SUCCESS. The PR is 376 lines.

Bs: none.

Merge note (not a B, but this head cannot merge until it is done): GitHub now reports this PR as conflicting. Main took m#518 (ONB-RESEND, merge 2e12b0af, 16:15 PDT). A read-only `git merge-tree` shows two conflicts:
- `src/screens/auth/LoginScreen.tsx`, imports only. Keep main's `import ResendVerificationLink from './ResendVerificationLink';` and this PR's `import { useTheme } from '../../theme/ThemeProvider';`. This PR no longer uses `ThemeColors`; it uses `SemanticTokens` from `theme/tokens`. m#518's other Login hunks merge cleanly and must survive: the `errorUnconfirmed` state, `showFailure(describeSignInFailure(err), true)` on email sign-in, and `<ResendVerificationLink email={email} testID="login-resend" />` inside the error box. If they are dropped, FW-ONB-128 B1 comes back: a new client whose confirmation email went missing gets no "Send a new link" when sign-in says the email is not confirmed.
- `src/screens/auth/README.md`. Keep this PR's ForgotPassword and ResetPassword rows, plus main's EmailVerified row (updated by m#518) and its ResendVerificationLink row.
After that merge, the next head needs only a delta re-review of the merge.

Cs:
- C: LN-OPUS-B-128's two Cs still apply: Sign in is the primary action on Welcome, and the title "Sign in." ends with a period. Both are product or style choices.
